title: The Best Segway Gaudi Tour in barcelona
text:
Best time ever and now ticked off my bucket 🪣 list, we had a great teacher the guy in  the shop gave us a quick 15 min pre lesson, the guide was fantastic Pau was so knowledgeable on the city and Gaudi we both loved 😍 it l!!! and want to go again next on the mountain tour. 

By the end I felt like I'd seem much more of Barcelona and more of a whiz on the segway I could even do a little with no hands. 

Highly recommended. Very flexible, trusting and as we didn't have cash they let us pay on the way back on the segway he even took us to the cashpoint with less fees. We've had a fantastic aftern
author: SashyB
